# Generated orchestrators

**Read-only context note.** Everything under `orchestrators/<department>/` is generated by the corresponding Enablement Subagent during Phase 5 of the build. Do not hand-edit these files for v1 — if you find yourself wanting to, the right fix is almost always in the generating agent (`enablement_agents/<department>/`).

## Runtime vs. build-time

The agents in this directory are **runtime** agents — they handle inbound customer interactions for Serenia & Co. They are distinct from the build-time Coordinator and Enablement Agents that produced them.

## Structure each orchestrator must have

A generated orchestrator follows the layout specified in Phase 5.1 of `BUILD_PLAN.md`:
- `orchestrator.py` — runtime entry point (fetches AI Config variation via `ld_ai.config`, emits `ld_client.track` events)
- `agent_definition.py` — the runtime agent's `AgentDefinition`
- `prompts/v1_baseline.md` — baseline prompt; corresponds to the `v1-baseline` AI Config variation
- `prompts/v2_detailed_responses.md` — v2 prompt; differs from `v1_baseline.md` by one added instruction that drives the hallucination regression the multi-signal guardrails tutorial demonstrates
- `judges/factual_accuracy.md` — judge prompt that scores factual accuracy against `data/support/policies.md`; LaunchDarkly auto-generates `support.judge.factual_accuracy` when attached
- `.mcp.json` — MCP server references for each tool in the stack
- `mcp_servers/<tool>/` — per-tool MCP server (stubs in v1)
- `observability.py` — OTel instrumentation
- `.env.example` — credentials required (must be a strict subset of root `.env.example`)
- `Makefile` — `make run` target
- `README.md` — how to run, what it does
- `ai_configs.manifest.yaml` — manifest consumed by `scripts/setup_ai_configs.py`

## Behavioral contract

Each orchestrator must satisfy the runtime contract in Phase 5.2 of `BUILD_PLAN.md`. The deterministic tests in `tests/orchestrators/` verify the contract against stubs.

The architectural principles for this directory are in `@../.claude/rules/orchestrator-conventions.md`.
